LinkedIn company search URL (/search/results/companies/?keywords=<short name>) plus find with 'href' works well; long names return no results, use acronym + USC. Guessing Instagram handles costs a load each and failed 4 of 4 (hultprizeusc, uscimpactinvesting, exit.sc, usc_evma).
Catalog discrepancy: EVMA instagram in catalog is uscmarshallevma, but clubs.marshall.usc.edu/evma links instagram.com/usc_evma, which 404s on Instagram. Verify catalog handle.

HTA also has a legacy LinkedIn group on clubs.marshall.usc.edu; the company page hta-usc-marshall is preferred. CyNet Accelerator (linkedin.com/company/usc-cynet-accelerator/, 90 followers) is affiliated with HTA/EVMA and is not in the catalog.

Host entries marked 'not opened' come from the host site's own footer link and were not loaded in Chrome. ~26 Instagram/LinkedIn page loads used.
